name: EMA crossover trend
description: A long-only trend template that enters when a faster exponential average crosses above a slower one and exits on the reverse cross. Use it as a starting point; backtest results are simulations, not promises of future performance.
market_idea: A sustained move may keep the fast average above the slow average after a trend begins.
typical_failure_mode: Sideways prices can create repeated crossovers and whipsaw losses; both averages also react after price has already moved.

name: SMA crossover trend
description: A long-only trend template that enters when a faster simple average crosses above a slower simple average and exits on the reverse cross. Use it as a starting point; backtest results are simulations, not promises of future performance.
market_idea: A broad price move may persist long enough for the faster average to lead the slower average.
typical_failure_mode: Moving averages lag turning points and can alternate rapidly when price has no sustained direction.

name: RSI oversold reversion
description: A long-only mean-reversion template that enters below an RSI threshold and exits after RSI rises through a higher threshold. Use it as a starting point; backtest results are simulations, not promises of future performance.
market_idea: A sharp decline may partly reverse when recent losses ease and momentum returns toward its middle range.
typical_failure_mode: A persistent decline can keep RSI oversold while the position continues losing; an oversold reading alone does not establish a floor.

name: RSI midline momentum
description: A long-only momentum template that enters when RSI crosses above a center threshold and exits when it crosses back below. Use it as a starting point; backtest results are simulations, not promises of future performance.
market_idea: Momentum moving from below to above a chosen center can be used as a simple direction filter.
typical_failure_mode: The center-line signal can lag abrupt reversals and produce false starts when price oscillates around the threshold.

name: Trend-filtered RSI pullback
description: A long-only pullback template that requires price above a long simple average while RSI is below a pullback threshold; it exits if the trend filter fails or RSI reaches its exit threshold. Use it as a starting point; backtest results are simulations, not promises of future performance.
market_idea: A temporary momentum dip inside a longer-term uptrend may be a continuation setup rather than a trend reversal.
typical_failure_mode: The trend filter can turn down late, and a pullback can deepen into a full reversal before RSI recovers.

name: Price-to-SMA reversion
description: A long-only mean-reversion template that enters when price crosses below its simple average and exits after price crosses back above it. Use it as a starting point; backtest results are simulations, not promises of future performance.
market_idea: A move back toward a recent average can provide a simple reference for testing short-horizon reversions.
typical_failure_mode: In a sustained selloff, price may remain below its average or continue falling before it crosses back.
